notes: A page target: say about how many pages you want when you create the album. Design album then keeps the best photo of each group of similar shots and gives every story a fair share; hero and favorite photos always stay, and the others wait off the pages, marked with the reason
Photos are split into stories by the calendar: Hour, Half day, Day, Week, Month, Year or Never, with the period that suits your photos suggested. An evening past midnight stays together
The cover works like a spread: move, resize, crop, add and remove its photos, Redesign cover with arrows through the layouts, ten starting layouts (even none), and Undo for the cover
Alternatives and Keep together are switches: click again to take them off; a photo is never both; no more Ungroup button
A clearer start: a one-minute "Start here" video offered the first time you use FlowAlbum, beside Design album, and before your first design; the guides panel opens once when videos are suggested
New guide videos: your album's length, a cover like a spread, sharing the album as a book, and what works without a Claude key
